settings.heading: Who is this for?
settings.item_text: We make footwear, gear, and apparel for the golf enthusiast. We value those who share our excitement for the game, the brand, and aspire to invest in individuals who embody what it means to #LiveTRUE. We are currently welcoming those with certified experience in: Golf instruction, wellness, fitness/style influencers, professional athletes, trainers, golf personalities, or just straight up TRUE advocates. We're currently accepting a limited number of entries, so unfortunately not everyone will be accepted to the program at this time; however, we'll be sure to keep your application on file for future consideration.

settings.heading: What do you receive?
settings.item_text: In exchange for what you bring to the community, we're proud to offer a unique 40% off personal use code on new footwear/apparel products so you can focus on what you do best - on and off the course. We'll also offer seasonal friends/family discounts, exclusive product/event access, giveaways, and additional perks unavailable elsewhere.

settings.heading: What do we ask?
settings.item_text: Show us how you #EnjoytheWalk and #LiveTRUE in your community while tagging @truelinkswear along in your adventures. Create/share fun, engaging content with your followers, friends, and us! By accepting entry into The Collective, you're allowing us to share your story on our channels as well (including image, name, and content).

settings.heading: Do I need to reapply?
settings.item_text: If you're approved, you will not need to reapply to continue in The Collective. While we wish we could let this program run in perpetuity, we'll review accounts on a bi-yearly basis to ensure you're representing and engaging with TRUE on a somewhat regular basis.

settings.heading: Can I share my code?
settings.item_text: We'll offer seasonal friends and family discounts, but your code is unique to yourself.

settings.heading: Matt Ginella
settings.overlay_description: DAD. STORYTELLER. GOLF ADVENTURIST. Matt Ginella has been covering golf for 25 years. First at Sports Illustrated, then Golf Digest and Golf World magazines and most recently for Golf Channel, where he appeared as the Travel Insider for “Morning Drive” and wrote for Golf Advisor.com. He founded the multimedia company 'Fire Pit Collective' and continues to explore and uncover golf destinations worldwide.

settings.heading: Keith Bennett
settings.overlay_description:
HUSBAND. FATHER. PUG LOVER. PGA Certified Instructor, and Golf Digest's Best Young Teacher for 2023-2024, Keith embodies everything TRUE strives to be. An avid golfer, and friend to many, his enthusiasm and dedication to the game (and endless pursuit of improvement in himself, and others) makes us proud to have him lace up TRUE for every lesson, match, and post-round celebration.

Instagram: @keithbennettgolf

settings.heading: Shawn Clement
settings.overlay_description:
WISDOM. IN. GOLF. Shawn Clement, CPGA, is a well establish instructor per his residence at the Royal Québec Golf Club and online instructional program Wisdom in Golf, which is based on a solid anatomical background and promotes a natural swing. The WIG team includes professional golfer and Director of Marketing, Savannah Meyer-Clement and Head Kinesiologist, Munashe Masawai.

Instagram: @wisdomingolf

settings.heading: Carson Kemp
settings.subheading: Fitness Pro and Owner at MotionLab
settings.overlay_description:
FAMILY. COUNTRY. 'FITNESSING'.
Head of Fitness at MotionLab in Scottsdale, AZ, Carson is a Military Veteran and with his love of fitness and golf devotes his time and effort in to making people better through functional fitness. Carson trains some of the top PGA and LPGA tour players.

settings.heading: Glen Wesley
settings.overlay_description:
20 YEAR NHL VET. 2X STANLEY CUP CHAMP. AVID GOLFER. After a very successful NHL career, Glen now works for the St. Louis Blues doing player development with their drafted prospects and minor league team. When asked about the brand, Glen says, "TRUE has been the most comfortable shoe I’ve worn on or off the golf course." Whether he's heading to the rink, traveling from state to state, or just lounging around his house, TRUE has him covered.

Instagram: glen_e_wesley2

settings.heading: Scott Mills
settings.overlay_description:
As a sports chiropractor, the Dead Golfer really speaks to me in my bones. And while that’s a somewhat newer logo, I’ve been exclusively wearing TRUE golf shoes for more than a decade and have always appreciated their thoughtful approach to function and fashion. From the zero drop, natural footbed of the OG to the office to course ease of the FS01, TRUE has me covered. The new apparel additions have been exciting and of exceedingly high quality.

Instagram: @fullbodyfix

settings.heading: Sonny Garza
settings.overlay_description:
I knew this company was doing it right and I was immediately hooked when i purchased The All Day Hybrid Jogger. Look good and feel good while on the golf course and your daily life is what defines the TRUE Brand. The Lux Hybrid have been the most comfortable and best looking shoe I’ve used while golfing. They both have the great comfort in the right areas for golf and the right style while on the go.
